g.text: Labels are usually posted within days of their effective date, with a long tail either side
Version-weighted, 487,910 DailyMed versions with both dates. Median 3 days; 36,622 (7.5%) posted more than 90 days
after the effective date, 14,646 (3.0%) more than 365; 2,240 have an effective date after posting (red, 216 by more
than 30 days). This is an observed date difference between two recorded fields, not an FDA approval delay or a risk-
